About the specialist

A designer’s eye.
A systems mindset.

Good design gets attention. A thoughtful system carries it forward.

I’m the specialist behind BrightVictory Design. I design and build websites, landing pages and sales funnels for businesses with expertise worth sharing. I connect the customer-facing experience with the forms, bookings, CRM and follow-up that support it.

My approach combines a sharp visual eye with practical thinking: how it explains your offer, where each action leads, and what needs to happen after someone clicks.

How we work

A clear process,
every step of the way.

Six steps from the first conversation to launch and beyond. You always know what’s happening and what comes next.

  1. STEP 01

    Discover

    01

    Get to know your business

    We start with your offer, audience and goals. A focused conversation gives us a clear brief and a shared starting point.

  2. STEP 02

    Strategy

    02

    Map the customer journey

    We plan the pages, messaging and next steps, so every part of your website supports a clear business goal.

  3. STEP 03

    Design

    03

    Create and refine

    I shape the visuals, layouts and motion around your brand. You review the direction and we refine it together.

  4. STEP 04

    Build

    04

    Bring it to life

    I build the responsive website or funnel and connect the agreed forms, bookings, CRM and follow-up.

  5. STEP 05

    Launch

    05

    Go live with confidence

    We check the mobile experience, links and key customer journeys, then launch and hand over practical guidance.

  6. STEP 06

    Grow

    06

    Review and improve

    After launch, we identify useful refinements. Any ongoing optimisation or support is planned around your next priorities.
